items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: Not that much. We played quite a bit at the White Place, which he was leading up to play off the normal and advertised for Maison Blancenic.

ctx.x: Alto Oteno was? Alto. What was his first name, do you know? Maybe that was his first name, I don't know. I forgot. His first name, yeah. Did he ever play with you much?

Not that much. We played quite a bit at the White Place, which he was leading up to play off the normal and advertised for Maison Blancenic. He had that job in charge. But he sticked with Rene for a long time.
Who was in the Meilenburg job with Hickman? Who else?
